beats.care: It's only a proposal now. Leaving town on a festival weekend? Start early or use the metro to edge-of-city hubs.
beats.what: BTP is considering fixed hours for heavy and medium goods vehicles and private AITP buses on festivals and weekends.
beats.why: On Saturday, people spent 3–4 hours in traffic on Tumakuru Road, Mysuru Road and the airport road.

cards.body: Buses took 1–2 hours to go 4–5 km from Majestic to Sandal Soap Factory. Traffic was bumper-to-bumper from Hebbal to Mekhri Circle.
cards.title: How bad was it?

cards.body: GBA urban planner Deepa Managooli says private buses use unauthorised pick-ups like Govardhan Theatre and KR Puram. She suggests pick-up hubs near metro terminals.
cards.title: A planner's idea

cards.body: A July draft plan by traffic police already proposed keeping All India Permit buses out from 8 am to 10 pm.

opts: Fixing hours for heavy vehicles and private buses
cards.q: What's the main idea police are weighing?
cards.why: Police are considering limiting heavy vehicles and AITP buses to set hours on busy days.

cards.q: Should private buses board only outside the city?

hook: Could *private buses be kept out* of Bengaluru by day?

learn.t: Garbage trucks in central Bengaluru may be allowed to run only between 10 pm and 7 am.
